name: Gregor Lee
source: Down-to-earth and companionable, G is the sort of bartender that anyone can ask for. He’s got a listening ear and a mean drink for anyone in need of it, not because that’s his job, but because he actually enjoys what he does. Although there is plenty of trouble to be had, being around drunkards many hours of the day, he takes care of his patrons well enough and makes sure they get home safe, calling cabs for them, and keeping their car keys until they return sober. He has quite the live and let live policy, a necessity considering all the scuffles he had to get into with the more rowdy drunks.
